AgentManifest.description: agent.json of an agent bundle. orbit.agent/v1 files (schema, name, description, model as a string) are valid unchanged; every other field is new in orbit.agent/v2 and defaulted by the platform when absent. The file never holds credentials.

name.description: Name of the agent. The platform derives the asset slug from it.

version.description: Semantic version of the bundle. Published versions are immutable.

displayName.description: Display name by language tag, for example zh and en.

description.description: What the agent is for, in one sentence. The leader of a team reads it to pick members.

model.description: The model profile to use: a profile name, or a profile with fallbacks tried in order when it is unavailable.

rails.description: Agent rails to enable. The platform keeps an allow-list of rail types; others fail validation.

ModelSelection.description: A model profile and its fallbacks.

profile.description: Name of a model profile of the tenant.

fallback.description: Profiles to try, in order, when the first is unavailable.

builtin.description: Built-in tools to enable, from the platform allow-list.

type.description: Rail type from the platform allow-list, for example context_compression or circuit_breaker.

config.description: Parameters of the rail; their schema depends on type.

AgentLimits.description: Limits the agent asks for. They are capped by tenant policy.

maxIterationsPerRun.description: Maximum ReAct iterations across the whole run.

default_run_budget_millicredits.description: Integer millicredits (1000 = 1 credit). Credit budget of a run when the caller sets none.

SecretScope.description: Who owns the secret the agent asks for.

SecretDeclaration.description: A secret the agent needs. Only the name is declared; the value is bound by the installer.

NetworkDeclaration.description: Network rights the agent asks for.

egress.description: Domain patterns the sandbox may reach; everything else is denied.

AgentPermissions.description: Permissions the agent declares. They are the upper bound; tenant, workspace and user policy can only narrow them.

secrets.description: Secrets the agent may be granted.

dataScopes.description: Data the agent may read, for example session_files or workspace_knowledge:read.

effectClasses.description: Side-effect classes the agent may perform.

Compat.description: Versions of the platform the bundle was written for.

kernel.description: Version range of the agent kernel, as a pip requirement such as openjiuwen>=0.1.19,<0.2.

platform.description: Version range of the platform, such as >=1.0.
